conditions.question: Are move admissibility, maps, mobilities, and rates gauge- and anchor-automorphism-equivariant?
conditions.proof: Gauge acts trivially on root labels and commutes with every abelian coordinate update. Anchor automorphisms relabel vertex and cell roots, with the link sign transported by orientation_sign; the scalar mobilities and F_rho are invariant.

conditions.question: Does P_cand commute with L_rho on one declared finite invariant core?
conditions.proof: Root/rate equivariance gives U_h L_rho=L_rho U_h for the finite semidirect symmetry group. Averaging yields [P_cand,L_rho]=0 on A_rho^inv=range(P_cand).

conditions.question: Is B_rho^*B_rho=-L_rho exact with the declared measure, directed multiplicity, factor, and domain?
conditions.proof: D_rho carries pi(x) times exact directed-label counting measure, I(x,r)=(r.x,r^-1) preserves the weighted incidence measure by detailed balance, and sqrt(c/2) gives the reversible Dirichlet form exactly on the full finite function space and A_rho^inv.

conditions.question: Does the contract honestly distinguish relabelling naturality from nontrivial refinement?
conditions.proof: Anchor-preserving cell isomorphisms intertwine exactly but are explicitly excluded as refinement. The named free-vertex restriction refinement fails exact intertwining by a positive-kappa_s aperture-rate fibre dependence.
